text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Copano Rickey has a
number of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Trainer! Trainerrr!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Hot spring vacation!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Did it, though? I've been looking
forward to
this ever since we won the
tickets in that raffle. ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The timing's right! The weather's perfect!
If we head to a hot spring in an
auspicious direction,
we'll be able to
absorb so much luck! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: So let's get going! C'mon, c'mon! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We pack lightly and head to the hot
springs.
Once we arrive...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Phewww. The water was amazing. My head still feels a bit fuzzy, though...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But in terms of feng shui, it's nothing to
worry
about! This much might actually
be pretty lucky!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course there is!
I'll tell you all about
it!
choice_data_list: Is there a feng shui way to enter ...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here together, let's make
good use of
feng shui and make
ourselves super happy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I gratefully accept her offer to teach me
the feng
shui way.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
First, when you go to the open-air bath,
you need
to stand barefoot. Your feet
need to really feel
the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And if there's any drinkable spring
water, make
sure you have some. ♪ It'll
help the qi build up in
your body.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
As for food, you should eat the local

specialties. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Combining the effects of the bath with
your lucky
direction will have your
fortunes improving in no
time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After making a toast, we enjoy a feast of
local
treats. Then...
choice_data_list: Alright, let's order the special d...
All right, let's order the special...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chirp, chirp... Chirp...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's time for a morning bath! Face east
and soak
up the sunlight...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now your luck's all topped up! ☆ You're
shining
so brightly it's like you're a
different person,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Copano Rickey's effusive praise,
I can't help but feel good. We end up
enjoying a
thoroughly energizing
vacation.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now your fortunes are looking good in
all kinds of ways. ♪ Your luck with
money has especially
improved, which
means...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You might find yourself owning some
pretty nice
stuff in the future. For
example...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Nope. Something even better! Like...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: A condo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The living space of my dreams expands
in my
mind... A spacious layout, antique
furniture, a
wonderful view...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just coming on this hot spring vacation
was luxurious enough, but now even my
dreams have
become ridiculously
opulent.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I saw you smiling just now. ♪ Were you
picturing
your future?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether or not this dream will actually
come true
is a different story, though.
Either way, I feel like
I'm on cloud nine.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You've taken such good care of me,
Trainer. If
this trip has made you happy,
then I'm happy
too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's go for a walk after your
morning soak.
The greenery here is
gorgeous. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our vacation turns out to be a wonderful
one,
filled with all kinds of fresh and fun
experiences.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Copano Rickey and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
